tree.household.toml:
# Meal Prep Studio — household configuration.
# Everything personal lives in this folder; the tool itself stays generic.
name = "Meal Prep Studio"
language = "en"            # "en" or "de" (UI + everything Claude writes)

# Never suggested — checked in titles and ingredients ("without X" is fine).
exclusions = ["mushroom"]

[schedule]
days = 4                   # eating days per prep round
# freeze_days = 2           # optional: freeze the last N days on prep day
shopping_day = "sat"
prep_day = "sun"
first_day = "mon"

[budget]
per_round = 60
currency = "€"

# One entry per person. kcal = daily target, protein in g/day.
[[persons]]
id = "a"
label = "Alex"
name = "Alex"
kcal = 2200
protein = 150

[[persons]]
id = "b"
label = "Sam"
name = "Sam"
kcal = 1800
protein = 120

# Meals that are NOT planned (fixed breakfast, shake …) — subtracted from the daily target.
[[fixed_meals]]
name = "Breakfast"
text = "Oats with yogurt and berries"
kcal = 450
protein = 25
carbs = 55

# Meals Claude plans. Either `share` of what is left after fixed meals,
# or exact `targets = { a = 700, b = 560 }` per person.
[[meals]]
id = "lunch"
label = "Lunch · cold"
cold = true
share = 0.42

[[meals]]
id = "dinner"
label = "Dinner · warm"
share = 0.58

# Supermarket offers (Germany/Austria via marktguru). Set enabled = false elsewhere.
[offers]
enabled = false
zip = ""
retailers = ["aldi-sued", "lidl", "netto-marken-discount", "kaufland", "rewe", "edeka"]
markup = { rewe = 1.15, edeka = 1.15 }   # regular-price surcharge vs. discounters
second_store_min_saving = 3.0            # only suggest a second store if it saves this much

[agent]
command = "claude"         # Claude Code CLI, logged in
model = "sonnet"           # sonnet = fast & good; opus = slower, more careful
candidates_per_meal = 4

[server]
port = 8090
pin = ""                   # set a PIN if other people use your Wi-Fi

tree.profile.md:
# Household profile

Write freely — Claude reads this whole file before every suggestion.

## Who eats
- Two adults, office jobs, little exercise.

## Goals
- Lose weight slowly, stay full. Enough protein.

## Medical / intolerances (always wins)
- (e.g. lactose intolerance, insulin resistance: low GI, starch last)

## Likes
- Cheesy bakes, Mediterranean food, spicy is fine.

## Dislikes
- Mushrooms (never).

## Kitchen
- 1 oven with 2 racks, 1 sheet pan, 2 baking dishes, 1 large non-stick pan, pots.
- Prep day may take about 75 minutes.

## Shopping
- Prefer one store. Budget see household.toml.

tree.profile.md:
# Haushaltsprofil

Frei schreiben — Claude liest die ganze Datei vor jedem Vorschlag.

## Wer isst
- Zwei Erwachsene, Bürojobs, wenig Bewegung.

## Ziele
- Langsam abnehmen, satt bleiben, genug Protein.

## Medizinisch / Unverträglichkeiten (hat immer Vorrang)
- (z. B. Laktoseintoleranz, Insulinresistenz: niedriger GI, Beilage zuletzt)

## Mögen wir
- Überbackenes mit Käse, mediterran, darf scharf sein.

## Mögen wir nicht
- Pilze (niemals).

## Küche
- Backofen mit 2 Schienen, 1 Backblech, 2 Auflaufformen, 1 große beschichtete Pfanne, Töpfe.
- Prep-Tag darf ca. 75 Minuten dauern.

## Einkauf
- Am liebsten ein Laden. Budget siehe household.toml.
